assets: the AWS account and its stacks (infra/aws/stacks)
the media bucket and its replica (DATA-r2-media)
the doorbell's bearer token and the service's tokens
boundaries: GitHub Actions (the doorbell workflow) and the AWS deploy it rings
the internet and the service's HTTP port

threats.statement: Someone rings the doorbell or calls the service's port without being the merge's workflow or a known tenant.
A deploy runs code that is not main's merged commit, or a session changes production by hand.
A deploy or a production change cannot be traced to the merge that rang it.

A production credential or database URL leaks to a cloud session, a log or the repository. Residual: the merge queue's prepare job runs the queued commit's scripts/lib/deploy.py with the doorbell's token, so code not yet merged holds that token; its role can only start the deploy and call the port's alias.
A deletion, a provider failure or a regional loss takes the database or the media. Residual: a compromised or closed account loses both copies (RISK-media-single-account).
A flood of calls to the public doorbell or the service's port starts builds or work that spend the account's budget or keep the real deploy waiting.

The doorbell's token, held in GitHub's secrets, or a deploy role reaches more than ringing the deploy. Residual: the tests bound the roles of infra/aws/bootstrap.json (a permissions boundary on every role, the doorbell only starts the deploy, the deployer only the app stacks) and pin the file to the hash the Torre applied; what the account runs between a change and its re-apply, or after a change made outside the tree, is not read back by any test.

findings.finding: STD-service-credentials-refused-sentence only words the message of a refused token; it refuses nothing.
findings.reason: replaced by infra-aws.test.sh, which proves the doorbell compares its token in constant time over SHA-256.

findings.finding: The proof that the build deploys main's head (BootstrapTests) was not named.
The doorbell's token is handed to the queued commit's own deploy.py in the merge queue's prepare job, before that commit is merged.
findings.reason: residual added; the token's role is bounded by test_the_doorbell_can_only_start_the_deploy, and entering the queue takes write access.

findings.finding: No threat covered a flood of the public doorbell or the port (cost and starvation).
findings.reason: threat added, mitigated by the doorbell's throttle, alarm and dead letters (infra-aws), the port's limits (infra-port) and REQ-aws-200.

findings.finding: The residual "no test bounds the IAM policies of the stacks" is out of date: test_infra_aws.py BootstrapTests bounds every role, the doorbell and the deployer.
findings.reason: residual rewritten to what is left (the account's applied state is not read back); infra-aws.test.sh added.
